nodes.ariaLabel: Trigger node: When a new email arrives

config.markdown:
Triggers when any new email arrives in the shared request inbox with the subject filter "email triage".
Make sure that the correct folder is selected.
Template Note: You can modify the categories based on the common noise in your shared mailbox.

Main brain of the flow. Analyzes the request, decides category & routingTeamEmail, drafts acknowledgment and internal summary.

Sends polite acknowledgment to the person who submitted the request.

Dynamically sends the internal alert to the correct team using the routingTeamEmail from the Agent Node (no Switch needed).

config.inlineInstructions:
You are an expert Inbound Request Orchestrator.

Extracted information from the email:
subject: {triggerOutputs()?['body/subject']}
body: {triggerOutputs()?['body/body']}
requestor: {triggerOutputs()?['body/from']}

CRITICAL CLASSIFICATION RULES - Follow this priority order STRICTLY:
1. HR / Onboarding: "new joiner", "new hire", "onboarding", "new employee", "start date", "joining", "maternity leave", "resignation"
2. Finance: "invoice", "payment", "billing", "vendor", "PO", "budget", "expense report", "tax", "reimbursement"
3. Sales: "lead", "opportunity", "RFP", "proposal", "demo", "pricing", "enterprise solution", "new business"
4. IT / Technical Support: "VPN", "login", "password reset", "account locked", "cannot connect", "error", "connection timed out", "software installation", "hardware failure", "laptop", "phishing", "security", "access issue", "system down"
5. Facilities: "conference room", "book room", "meeting room", "workshop"
6. Other: everything else
Your tasks:
- Analyze the request using the rules above
- Decide finalCategory and routingTeamEmail amd urgency
- Draft acknowledgmentText
- Draft internalSummary
- Build internalEmailBody
- **Send exactly two emails using the "Send an Email" tool**:
- First: Send **Acknowledgment Email** to the original requester.
- Second: Send **Internal Routing Email** to the correct team.
The routing email mapping can be found here: {variables('RoutingEmails')}

**Tool Usage Instructions (Very Important):**
- You **must** use the Send an Email tool for both emails.
- Send the acknowledgment email **first**, then the internal email.
- Use the requester's email address from the original trigger for the acknowledgment.
- Use HTML format for the internal email body for better readability.
- Neither the acknowledgement email nor the routing email should contain 'email triage' in their subject lines.
**After successfully sending both emails, return ONLY this valid JSON:**

config.markdown:
Template Note: Configure the required variables:

RoutingEmails: Email ids for the respective routing team. If you are modifying the categories themselves, make sure to update the agent prompt as well to match the categories.

categories.name: Actionable request
categories.description: A genuine human-authored request that requires review or action. Includes requests for help, access, onboarding, invoices, payments, sales inquiries, technical support, facilities, approvals, questions, or other business services. Select this category only when the sender is asking for information, assistance, or an action. Do not select it for automated messages, acknowledgments, notifications, newsletters, delivery reports, or unsubscribe requests.

categories.name: Noise
categories.description: An automated, non-actionable, or irrelevant email that should not enter request triage. Includes out-of-office or absence notices; automatic replies and acknowledgments; vacation responses; delivery status notifications, bounce messages, and undeliverable reports; read receipts; mailbox notifications; system-generated alerts with no request for action; newsletters, marketing, promotions, and mailing-list messages; unsubscribe or subscription-management requests; spam; empty messages; and messages that merely confirm receipt. Select this category when the email does not contain a genuine human request requiring business action.
